title: Handlebar Lock & Helmet Lock Combo – Anti-Theft Protection in Aluminum
descriptionHtml:
Protect the bike and the helmet

Motorcycles and helmets are unfortunately popular targets for thieves. A good lock gives peace of mind when you park and leave the vehicle.

Heavy-duty lock in aluminum alloy

This combo lock works as both a handlebar lock and a helmet lock. It is made of solid aluminum alloy and gives sturdy protection against theft.

Features

  • Works as a handlebar lock and a helmet lock
  • Solid aluminum alloy
  • Sturdy protection against theft
  • Fits motorcycle, scooter and bicycle
  • Compact and easy to take along

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
